source: Talent trees and every rank's text from the WoW Forever beta client, build 1.60.1.70755. Some Rogue numbers follow Blizzard's development notes of 2 Nov 2026, ahead of any game data. The Rogue trees carry the server's hotfixes of 3 Nov 2026 over that build, read from the beta's hotfix cache and cross-checked with Blizzard's notes or Wowhead's tooltips; those are not in the client's files.

attribution.readme: talentsforever.com data export for the Rogue. Fan-made WoW Forever talent calculator; talents, racials, Legacy perks and the class spellbooks come from the WoW Forever beta client's own data files (the site began as frame-by-frame reads of the BlizzCon 2026 demo), so numbers can lag live tuning. A class can carry the server's hotfixes over the build it was read from, where the client's files do not have them: that class's talents.source line says so and names the days, and a spell rank a hotfix changed names it in its src. talents: per class, trees with talents (row/col are 1-based grid positions, max is the rank cap, desc lists the tooltip text of each rank, rank 1 first, as the client's files give it at level 60, or in the game's own words where a rank was read in game; confirmed lists the ranks whose text is real and not an estimate, which is every rank for trees from the beta client; classic compares the talent with Classic Era: status same, moved, changed or new, Classic's tree, row, col, rank count and rank 1 text, and renamed, note or replaces where they apply). spellbooks: per class, every trainer spell to level 60 with every rank (levels = the level each rank is learned at; checked = that class's city trainer was read in game, the rest are from the files only; the General tab is kept by hand from the demo and in-game reads). spell_desc: tooltip text keyed class|spell|rank, s=beta means the beta client's text at level 60 with no gear, s=demo means read off the BlizzCon demo footage, or read in game where src begins Read in game, s=classic means Wowhead Classic fallback, nt=1, 2, 3 or 4 means the class trainer does not sell that rank (1 portal trainer, 2 tome, quest or drop, 3 comes with the talent: taking the talent puts it in the book, 4 not sold by the class trainer, checked in game, and where it is learned is not known yet), ns=quest means a class quest teaches it (Wowhead Forever and Blizzard's notes), not a trainer read. racials and legacy: racial abilities and the Legacy perk trees.
